campaign: EKF baro vertical-velocity aid: latched minimum activation altitude
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
gate: aid active only if outage context (GNSS stale, no fresh flow, g_mode_degraded_gnss) and baro altitude at first age>8 s is >=10 m; latched for that outage. 10 m cells activate at ~8 m and remain disarmed.

scenarios.a10: 10 m target, 20 s outage, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 dirs x 10 seeds, aid off/on
scenarios.a20: 20 m target, 20 s outage, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 dirs x 10 seeds
scenarios.a60: 30 m target, 60 s outage, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 dirs x 10 seeds

verdict: The 10 m regression is eliminated: aid on/off are bit-identical with 0 attempts. 20 m and 60 s benefits are retained exactly. The aid is now scoped to activation altitude >=10 m, no-flow GNSS outage, g_mode_degraded_gnss, age>8 s. Default off.
caveats: Activation altitude uses baro_altitude at the first 5 Hz evaluation after age>8 s; if baro is invalid the aid does not arm.
The 10 m cell's initial altitude is 9.9 m and its activation altitude is ~8 m, so it is below the 10 m threshold; 20 m activates ~18 m.
All numbers are scalar-Eigen SIL L2, not real aircraft.
